captions.calm: A calm day at the oasis

video.clipNote: A short 24-second scene that changes every time. Watch everything that moves.

video.intro_f: Watch the scene closely, and then I'll ask you a few things.

balloons.q: How many balloons rose into the sky?
balloons.hint: Count every balloon, in every colour.

lastColor.q: What colour was the last balloon?
lastColor.hint: Think of the balloon just before the scene ended.

firstColor.q: What colour was the first balloon?
firstColor.hint: The first balloon rose near the start.

birds.hint: The birds fly high, across the sky.

birdFrom.q: Where did the first bird come from?
birdFrom.hint: Remember the first bird and which side it came in from.

camelFrom.q: Where did the camel come from?
camelFrom.hint: The camel walked low, on the sand.

star.q: Did a star appear in the sky?
star.hint: The star twinkles for a moment, then fades.

palms.q: How many palm trees were in the scene?
palms.hint: The palms stand still, down by the water.

first.hint: Think of the first thing that moved.

mem.wasThis: No worries, let's try a different approach. It was a {{object}}.
mem.memorize: Remember the things and their colours
mem.hint: It was in space {{slot}}, and its color was {{color}}.

seq.whyLast: because leaving comes after you finish getting ready

event.title: Example: getting ready for a gathering
event.note: Because you saved that you have an event.
event.whyFirst: because knowing the time shapes the other steps

work.title: Example: a morning before work
work.note: A general example, not from your schedule.

study.note: A general example, not from your schedule.

seq.guide: Drag a card, or tap it to send it to the first empty space.
seq.rightNote: That makes sense. You can swap the middle steps however suits you.
seq.almost: Good! There's just one step I'd move.
seq.finalNote: This is your final order, and what matters is that you tried.
seq.finalSay: No worries, what matters is that you tried.

time.over: That took a bit longer than you guessed. No problem, time flies.
time.under: You finished sooner than you guessed.
time.note: You estimated {{est}}, and it took {{act}}. The difference was {{err}}.
time.question: How many seconds do you think it takes to quietly count from 1 to 10?
time.explain: The difference is the gap between your estimate and the actual time.
time.countNow: Count from 1 to 10 now, and press stop as soon as you finish.
time.pressStart: Press start, count from 1 to 10, then stop.
time.quiet: I'll stay quiet while you count...

calm.intro: Take it easy. Choose what suits you, and you can stop any time.
calm.breathGuide: Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth.
calm.quietGuide: No guided breathing. Just take this time to be quiet.
calm.done: You took it at your own pace.
calm.how: How would you like it today?
calm.tone: A soft tone with each breath
calm.disclaimer: If it bothers you, stop it from the top.

sigh.name: Sigh
sigh.note: Two breaths in, a long breath out

guide.sigh: Breathe in, then a short extra breath in, then a long breath out through the mouth.
guide.long: In through the nose, a longer breath out through the mouth.
guide.even: Breathe in and out for the same length, at your ease.

start.intro: We'll start with just one small step.
start.notStarted: That's okay, you tried. We can come back to it when it suits you.
start.taskQ: What task have you been putting off?
start.taskPh: Write it in your own words
start.stepQ: What's the smallest first step? Just two minutes.
start.error: Write the task and the step so we can start.
start.privacy: What you type is saved in your private account and isn’t sent anywhere else. You can delete it in My Profile.
start.goDoIt: Go do it while the clock runs here. You can pause it from the top.
start.honest: The timer ending doesn't mean the task is done. Choose what really happened. Any answer is fine.

attention.intro_one: There's {{count}} difference. Take your time, there's no timer.
attention.intro_other: There are {{count}} differences. Take your time, there's no timer.
attention.note: You found {{found}} differences, with {{misses}} taps on something that stayed the same.
attention.same: {{item}} didn't change. Compare with the first scene.

hints.right_top: Check the top right of the scene.
hints.right_bottom: Check the bottom right of the scene.
hints.left_top: Check the top left of the scene.
hints.left_bottom: Check the bottom left of the scene.

attention.explain: A difference can be a new colour, something moved, something missing or something new. If something is missing, tap where it was.

seeds.work: Finish a work or study task

notToday.title: Not today
notToday.note: We'll leave it for another time

priority.intro: Put each task where it belongs. There's no wrong answer.
priority.note: You chose to start with: {{item}}. You have {{later}} for later and {{notToday}} for another day.
priority.editLists: I want to edit the lists
priority.addPh: Add a task of your own
priority.full_one: "Now" only has {{count}} space. What can wait?
priority.full_other: "Now" only has {{count}} spaces. What can wait?
priority.guide: Drag a card, or tap it and then tap a list.
priority.needOne: Put at least one thing in "Now".

steps.c: Study the first lesson for 25 minutes

when.home: As soon as I get home

breakdown.say1: What's the big thing weighing on you?
breakdown.say3: When will you start the first step?
breakdown.taskPh: Write it in your own words, or pick an example
breakdown.title: Break down:
breakdown.noSteps: No steps yet. Keep them small enough to start without much thought.
breakdown.oneEnough: One step is enough for this version.
breakdown.fiveEnough: That's enough, 5 steps will cover it.
breakdown.orType: Or type a time that suits you
breakdown.note: Your plan: {{when}}, you will: {{step}}. The points are for the plan, not for doing it, because we can't verify that.
breakdown.nowNo: No, save them to my goals
breakdown.savedGoals: I put your steps in today's goals.

study.intro: A short session at your pace.
study.timeUp: Time's up. How did it go?
study.doneNo: That's okay, some sessions go that way.
study.doneGood: Nice. Another session whenever it suits you.
study.noteParked_one: You focused for {{time}} and parked one distraction.
study.noteParked_other: You focused for {{time}} and parked {{count}} distractions.
study.topicPh: For example: chapter three, or the work report
study.quiet: I'll stay quiet. Note down anything distracting.
study.parkLabel: A distraction to park for later
study.parkPh: Distracted? Note it here and come back
study.parkedCount_one: You've parked {{count}}. We'll come back to it after the session.
study.parkedCount_other: You've parked {{count}}. We'll come back to them after the session.
study.minNote: You can finish after the first minute. If this isn't working, use "End" at the top.
study.phoneTip: Put your phone away or on silent before you start.
study.goalsQ: Add what you parked to today's goals?

emotion.intro: Take your time. You can skip anything.
emotion.said: You told me: {{feelings}}. Thanks for sharing.
emotion.note: These are your words, saved only in your private account. If things feel heavy, talk to someone you trust or a professional.
emotion.feelQ: How do you feel right now?
emotion.feelNote: You can choose more than one. I don't guess. This is your answer.
emotion.privacy: Your answers are saved in your private account, are not sent to the AI service, and earn no points.
emotion.ownPh: Or write it in your own word
emotion.heavy: This feeling sounds heavy right now. You don't have to carry it alone: talk to me, or to someone you trust.
emotion.chatQ: Want to talk with me for a bit now?

landscape.intro: Take a moment. There's nothing you have to do.
landscape.sceneLabel: A calm oasis with lanterns, palm trees and water
landscape.ready: Take your time, and come back when you're ready.
landscape.guide: Tap the lanterns, water or palm tree, or just look. The end button will be ready shortly.
landscape.pickQ: What do you need right now?

neck.title: Your neck
neck.how: Tilt your head gently to each side.

shoulders.title: Your shoulders
shoulders.how: Lift your shoulders up, then let them drop. Repeat.

stretch.title: Stretch
stretch.how: Stand up, raise your arms over your head and stretch.
stretch.say: Stretch as far as feels good.

walk.title: Walk a little
walk.how: Walk around the room or get some water.

moves.after: How do you feel after moving?

plan.title: Plan Your Day
plan.instructions: These are the things you mentioned. Put each one under Now, Later or Not today. There's no wrong answer, and not everything has to happen today.
plan.tasksNote: Add at least two things in your own words. They are saved in your private account.
plan.addPh: For example, the course you're taking
plan.needTwo: Add at least two to plan between them.
plan.sortQ: What's for now, and what can wait?
plan.sortNote: Your call. There's no wrong order.
plan.sortGuide: Tap a card, then tap where it goes. You can also drag it.
plan.needNow: Put at least one thing under Now.
plan.timeQ: How much time do you realistically have?
plan.timeNote: If you're not sure, plan priorities only. That's a good plan too.
plan.blocksNote: Set how long each one gets, and the order. Leave some breathing room if you like.
plan.over: {{n}} min over the time you have. Shorten something or move it to Later.
plan.doneSay: Nice, that's a plan you chose.

say.tasks: Tell me what's on your plate.
say.sort: Not everything has to happen today.
say.time: Let's fit it into your time.

plan.followUp: Want help turning that into a plan for the week?

micro.taskPh: Write the task in your own words
micro.ownPh: Something you could do in a minute or two

ladder.block: Work on it for 15 focused minutes
ladder.part: Do one small part of it
ladder.where: Open it and find where you stopped
ladder.ready: Put what you need in front of you

micro.modeQ: How do you want to try it?
micro.noTimer: No clock. Come back whenever you're ready.
micro.goNow: Go do it. I'll wait here.
micro.honest: Any answer is fine. Not yet is useful to know too.

say.shrink: Smaller is better. Shrink it till it feels easy.
say.mode: Pick a pace that suits you.
say.write: Write it your way. Small is enough.

done.started: You started. That's the hardest part.
done.bit: A little is still a start.
done.not: That's okay. The step is ready for when you are.

note.started: Starting with a small step often makes the next one easier.
note.not: Not starting today is fine. Your first step is saved for next time.

micro.knowQ: Do you know your first step?

intro.dhikr_morning: Good morning. Let us start the day with the remembrance of Allah.
intro.dhikr_evening: Good evening. Let us end the day with dhikr.
intro.dhikr_calm_heart: Take a breath, and say it slowly.
intro.dhikr_moment: A minute for you, at your own pace.

dhikr.free: No fixed number: say it as many times as you like.
dhikr.needOne: Say at least one dhikr for it to count, or leave with the Skip button above.
dhikr.done: May Allah accept it from you.

eye.title: Your eyes need a break!
eye.lead: Look at something far away from you, like a window or the far end of the room, for 20 seconds.
eye.rule: The 20-20-20 habit: every 20 minutes in front of a screen, look at something about 6 metres (20 feet) away for 20 seconds. A simple habit that gives your eyes a break from the screen.
eye.lookAway: Now take your eyes off the screen and look far away.
eye.awayCue: Look away from the screen; the timer runs by itself.
eye.done: Well done! You gave your eyes the break they deserve
eye.doneSay: Well done! You gave your eyes the break they deserve

say.look: Just look far away, at your ease.

grounding.afterQ: How are you now, after the exercise?

grounding.said: You're back in the place you're in.
